note: Authored questions for the bird corpus. Every answer_contains string was checked against the indexed corpus before being written here: each appears verbatim, in between one and fourteen passages, so it is distinctive enough to identify a location without matching incidentally. Gold locations are derived from these strings by src/build_golden_set.py, never hand-listed. Deliberately spread across all four file formats, because half the point of this corpus is that .docx, .pptx and .xlsx are in it.
